SELECT s.stock_code, s.stock_name, s.market_type, sp.price_date, sp.open_price, sp.close_price, sp.high_price, sp.low_price, sp.volume FROM stock_price as sp JOIN stock as s on sp.stock_code = s.stock_code WHERE sp.stock_code IN
#{code}
AND sp.price_date = #{priceDate}
ORDER BY sp.volume DESC
ORDER BY sp.open_price DESC
ORDER BY sp.close_price DESC
ORDER BY s.stock_name DESC
ORDER BY sp.stock_code ASC
